review_candidates.title: System Admin / DevOps Lead
review_candidates.description: Job Description – DevOps Lead System Administrator / DevOps Lead (10+ Years) Location: Bangalore, India Work Mode: Hybrid Company: The Garage Platform India Pvt. Ltd. Website: The Garage About The Garage The Garage is a fast-growing technology innovation company with engineering teams in Orlando, USA and Bangalore, India. We design, build, and operate scalable digital platforms, enterprise solutions, and data-driven products that serve global clients across multiple industries. Our culture is built on ownership, collaboration, innovation, and engineering excellence. We believe in empowering talented professionals to solve complex challenges while providing them the autonomy to make meaningful technical decisions and drive organizational impact. As we continue to scale, we are looking for a highly capable System Administrator / DevOps Lead who can own our infrastructure operations, cloud ecosystem, automation strategy, and platform reliability. The Opportunity This is not a traditional support role. As the System Administrator / DevOps Lead, you will serve as the primary infrastructure and DevOps owner for our India and US engineering teams. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and optimizing enterprise-grade cloud environments while ensuring high availability, performance, and security across all systems. You will play a critical role in shaping our DevOps maturity, driving automation initiatives, and building a scalable infrastructure foundation for future growth. Key Responsibilities Systems Administration • Administer Linux and Windows server environments. • Manage Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, SSL certificates, identity management, and endpoint security. • Oversee system upgrades, patching, vulnerability remediation, and lifecycle management. • Ensure high availability and uninterrupted business operations. DevOps & CI/CD Ownership • Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar tools. • Automate build, test, deployment, and release processes. • Implement deployment strategies that enable faster and more reliable software delivery. • Collaborate closely with engineering teams to improve deployment efficiency. Infrastructure as Code & Automation • Drive infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies. • Eliminate manual processes through scripting and workflow automation. • Develop reusable infrastructure templates and deployment frameworks. • Promote DevOps best practices across engineering teams. Containerization & Kubernetes • Manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes. • Support cluster deployment, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting. • Improve application reliability and operational efficiency through container orchestration. Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Management • Implement and manage observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Datadog, or similar tools. • Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes. • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement following production incidents. • Maintain SLAs, uptime targets, and system reliability standards. Security & Compliance • Implement security best practices across infrastructure and DevOps operations. • Conduct security audits, access reviews, and vulnerability assessments. • Ensure compliance with organizational and client security requirements. • Partner with leadership to strengthen DevSecOps practices and governance frameworks. Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity • Develop and maintain disaster recovery plans. • Ensure backup strategies are regularly tested and validated. • Conduct periodic recovery drills and business continuity assessments. Leadership & Collaboration • Serve as the technical lead for infrastructure and DevOps functions. • Mentor junior engineers and system administrators. • Collaborate with engineering, product, security, and leadership teams across India and the United States. • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and establish best-in-class operational practices. What We're Looking For Required Experience • 8-10 years of experience in System Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, or DevOps roles. • Proven experience managing production-grade cloud environments. • Strong hands-on expertise with AWS (preferred), Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. Technical Skills • Advanced Linux administration and troubleshooting. • Strong networking fundamentals including VPCs, VPNs, routing, firewalls, DNS, proxies, and load balancers. • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration. • Expertise in Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or other IaC tools. • Strong scripting skills using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging frameworks. • Database administration exposure including MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. Professional Skills • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. • Ability to manage critical incidents calmly and effectively. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. • Passion for automation and operational excellence. • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities. Preferred Qualifications • Experience implementing DevSecOps practices. • Exposure to SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or similar compliance frameworks. • Experience supporting globally distributed engineering teams. • Background working in high-growth startups or product companies. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will: Establish a stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure landscape. Improve deployment speed and reliability through automation. Reduce manual operational effort through Infrastructure as Code. Strengthen monitoring, incident management, and disaster recovery readiness. Serve as a trusted technical leader for infrastructure and DevOps initiatives globally.

review_candidates.description: XL Pro Staffing & Consulting is seeking an IT Support & Network Administrator to provide hands-on technology support across our office locations. This position will be responsible for supporting employees, troubleshooting computers and office technology, maintaining network equipment, assisting with technology installations, and helping keep our day-to-day IT operations running smoothly. We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems and isn't afraid to encounter something they haven't seen before. You don't need to know every answer—you need the technical foundation, curiosity, and initiative to find the answer and follow issues through to resolution . Key Responsibilities Help Desk & Employee Support Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support to XL Pro employees. Troubleshoot Windows computers, software, connectivity, login, and account issues. Support Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and other Microsoft 365 applications. Install approved software, applications, drivers, and updates. Troubleshoot printers, monitors, docking stations, and other office technology. Provide remote and onsite support as needed. Document solutions and recurring technical issues. Network & Office Technology Maintain and troubleshoot office network equipment, including TP-Link Omada equipment, managed switches, wireless access points, and network connections. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, Ethernet, DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, switch-port, and basic VLAN issues. Install or replace network equipment and assist with network racks and cabling. Coordinate with internet providers, cabling contractors, and technology vendors when necessary. Computers & Hardware Diagnose laptop and desktop hardware issues. Set up, reset, reimage, repair, and prepare computers for employees. Troubleshoot hardware, software, peripherals, and device drivers. Assist with employee technology setup and equipment returns. Maintain and track company IT equipment and assets. Microsoft 365 Support Provide day-to-day support for Microsoft 365. Assist employees with Outlook, Teams, Microsoft Authenticator, MFA, and account issues. Perform authorized basic user administration, license assignments, security-group changes, and mailbox troubleshooting. Onsite & Field IT Support Travel to XL Pro offices and client locations when hands-on technical support is required. Install and troubleshoot computers, printers, network equipment, and other office technology. Install and support company-approved network-connected timekeeping devices at client locations. Assist with office technology moves, upgrades, and new deployments. Cybersecurity & Documentation Follow company cybersecurity and least-privilege practices. Verify required endpoint-security applications are operating properly. Recognize and appropriately escalate suspected phishing, malware, account compromise, or other security concerns. Maintain clear records of troubleshooting, equipment, network changes, installations, and resolutions. Required Qualifications Current CompTIA A+ certification required. 1–2+ years of professional IT support, help desk, desktop support, network support, or similar experience preferred. Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11. Experience troubleshooting computers, hardware, printers, and peripherals. Working knowledge of Microsoft 365. Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, IPv4, DHCP, DNS, Ethernet, Wi-Fi, managed switches, and VLANs. Ability to troubleshoot unfamiliar technical problems and research solutions. Strong communication and customer-service skills. Ability to explain technical issues to non-technical employees. Ability to provide both remote and onsite support. Ability to travel to company offices and client locations as needed. Preferred Qualifications Experience with any of the following is a plus, but not required : CompTIA Network+ or Security+ Microsoft technical certifications TP-Link Omada or similar managed networking platforms Microsoft Entra ID Microsoft Intune or other endpoint-management platforms Microsoft 365 administration Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools Structured cabling and network racks Multi-location IT environments Basic Azure or cloud infrastructure What We're Looking For Technical knowledge is important, but how you approach problems matters just as much . We're looking for someone who takes ownership of issues, asks good questions, researches unfamiliar problems, tests potential solutions, and follows through until the problem is resolved. Hands-on experience counts. Candidates who have built home labs, worked on networking projects, built computers, experimented with virtualization or cloud environments, or pursued other technical projects are encouraged to tell us about them. You don't need to know everything. You do need to be willing and able to figure things out.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述： 1、安全态势监控与告警处置：基于SIEM、态势感知、审计平台进行全网安全告警研判、日志关联分析，快速识别误报、漏报、高危攻击行为，完成告警分级处置与闭环跟进。 2、安全事件应急响应与溯源：负责网络攻击、入侵行为、异常访问、数据泄露等安全事件的应急处置、阻断隔离、取证溯源、影响评估，输出事件复盘报告、整改建议并推动落地。 3、漏洞全生命周期治理：负责IT资产漏洞扫描、风险评估、漏洞验证、复测闭环；跟进高危漏洞预警、0day漏洞研判，推动业务、运维、研发完成漏洞修复、配置加固，建立漏洞治理台账。 4、安全设备与平台运营维护：负责深信服EDR、XDR、上网行为管理、漏洞管理平台等安全设备日常运维、策略梳理、规则优化，保障安全防护体系稳定有效运行。 5、威胁情报与安全能力建设：跟踪最新攻防态势、攻击手法、威胁情报，沉淀检测规则、告警模型、防御策略；持续优化SOC运营流程、研判SOP，提升威胁发现与响应效率。 6、安全合规与专项保障：配合ISO27001、隐私合规、跨境数据合规自查与整改。 7、安全资料与资产管理：维护暴露面资产清单、漏洞数据、渗透测试报告、安全事件台账、设备配置、审计日志等安全资料，统一归档、定期更新，支撑内审、外审、第三方审核对接工作。 任职要求： 1、本科及以上学历，3‑5年网络安全、安全运营、SOC运维相关工作经验，熟悉企业网络架构、服务器、终端、云平台基础安全架构。 2、熟悉常见网络攻击原理，如SQL注入、XSS、弱口令、暴力破解、webshell、内网横向移动等，具备独立告警研判、事件溯源、应急处置能力。 3、熟练掌握主流安全产品原理与运维，了解深信服EDR/XDR、IP‑Guard、亿格云DLP，飞书安全中心，能独立完成策略优化、规则调优、误报治理。 4、熟悉漏洞管理流程，具备漏洞复测、风险定级、整改推动经验。 5、CET‑6，英语口语可胜任工作交流。 6、工作严谨细致，具备良好的风险意识、抗压能力、沟通推动能力。 7、具备基础脚本能力（Shell/Python）、日志分析、简单自动化运营能力者优先。 8、熟悉27000、NIST信息安全体系，了解CCPA、GDPR合规，具备合规自查、资料整理、审核对接经验优先。 9、持有CISP、CISSP等安全证书优先。

review_candidates.title: 嵌入式系统工程师（AR眼镜）
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 【岗位职责】 1. 负责AR眼镜嵌入式系统中间件开发、调试与优化，结合AR眼镜产品特性，设计高可靠性、低功耗的中间件方案，支撑上层应用稳定运行，解决开发过程中的技术难点。 2. 负责AR眼镜嵌入式系统移植、适配及稳定性模块开发，针对AR眼镜硬件架构，完成系统裁剪、移植调试，优化系统启动速度、运行稳定性及功耗控制，保障产品长期稳定运行。 3. 负责AR眼镜嵌入式系统BSP编译构建、版本管理及自动化工具开发，搭建高效的编译构建流程，开发自动化测试、调试工具，提升研发效率，降低运维成本。 4. 配合硬件、算法及应用团队，完成AR眼镜相关功能模块的联调对接，参与产品需求评审、技术方案设计，输出标准化技术文档（设计文档、调试手册、接口文档等）。 5. 跟踪嵌入式技术及AR智能硬件行业发展趋势，引入先进技术方案，持续优化现有系统架构，提升产品性能与竞争力。 【岗位要求】 1. 本科及以上学历，5年以上嵌入式系统开发工作经验，有智能穿戴、消费电子领域开发经验者优先。 2. 精通C/C++编程语言，熟悉至少2种常用RTOS系统（FreeRTOS, ThreadX, RT-Thread, Nuttx等），具备扎实的嵌入式系统理论基础，能独立完成系统开发与调试。 3. 具备以下任意一种模块开发经验：文件系统、日志系统、trace异常定位、内存优化、性能调优、SPI/UART等外设通信开发。 4. 有蓝牙耳机、智能音箱、智能手表/眼镜等智能穿戴设备开发经验者优先，熟悉AR眼镜硬件架构、显示驱动相关开发者加分。 5. 具备良好的学习能力、沟通协调能力和团队协作意识，做事主动积极，响应及时，能独立承担核心模块开发任务，抗压性强。 【加分项】 1. 了解常见GUI框架（TouchGFX, emWin, LVGL等），有AR眼镜显示界面相关开发经验者优先。 2. 具备丰富的日志模块开发、trace异常定位、死机重启等问题分析处理经验，能快速排查嵌入式系统疑难问题。 3. 有小程序多应用开发经历，熟悉Javascript/HTML/CSS语言，能配合完成AR眼镜配套小程序与设备的交互开发。 4. 熟悉Python、Shell脚本开发，精通Linux系统，能独立搭建嵌入式开发环境、开发自动化工具。
